1.web: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went out to meet the bridegroom.
1.asv: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

2.web: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
2.asv: And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

3.web: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
3.asv: For the foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them:

4.web: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
4.asv: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

5.web: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
5.asv: Now while the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

6.web: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
6.asv: But at midnight there is a cry, Behold, the bridegroom! Come ye forth to meet him.

7.web: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
7.asv: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

8.web: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
8.asv: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are going out.

9.web: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
9.asv: But the wise answered, saying, Peradventure there will not be enough for us and you: go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

10.web: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the marriage feast, and the door was shut.
10.asv: And while they went away to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage feast: and the door was shut.

11.web: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
11.asv: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

12.web: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
12.asv: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

13.web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
13.asv: Watch therefore, for ye know not the day nor the hour.

14.web: “For it is like a man, going into another country, who called his own servants, and entrusted his goods to them.
14.asv: Forit isaswhena man, going into another country, called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

15.web: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
15.asv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his several ability; and he went on his journey.

16.web: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
16.asv: Straightway he that received the five talents went and traded with them, and made other five talents.

17.web: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
17.asv: In like manner he also that received the two gained other two.

18.web: But he who received the one went away and dug in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
18.asv: But he that received the one went away and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.

19.web: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and reconciled accounts with them.
19.asv: Now after a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and maketh a reckoning with them.

20.web: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents besides them.’
20.asv: And he that received the five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: lo, I have gained other five talents.

21.web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
21.asv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

22.web: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents besides them.’
22.asv: And he also that received the two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: lo, I have gained other two talents.

23.web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
23.asv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

24.web: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter.
24.asv: And he also that had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou didst not sow, and gathering where thou didst not scatter;

25.web: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
25.asv: and I was afraid, and went away and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, thou hast thine own.

26.web: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
26.asv: But his lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I did not scatter;

27.web: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
27.asv: thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back mine own with interest.

28.web: Take away therefore the talent from him, and give it to him who has the ten talents.
28.asv: Take ye away therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him that hath the ten talents.

29.web: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
29.asv: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away.

30.web: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
30.asv: And cast ye out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

31.web: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
31.asv: But when the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the angels with him, then shall he sit on the throne of his glory:

32.web: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
32.asv: and before him shall be gathered all the nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as the shepherd separateth the sheep from the goats;

33.web: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
33.asv: and he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

34.web: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
34.asv: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

35.web: for I was hungry, and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty, and you gave me drink. I was a stranger, and you took me in.
35.asv: for I was hungry, and ye gave me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink; I was a stranger, and ye took me in;

36.web: I was naked, and you clothed me. I was sick, and you visited me. I was in prison, and you came to me.’
36.asv: naked, and ye clothed me; I was sick, and ye visited me; I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

37.web: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, and feed you; or thirsty, and give you a drink?
37.asv: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, and fed thee? or athirst, and gave thee drink?

38.web: When did we see you as a stranger, and take you in; or naked, and clothe you?
38.asv: And when saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

39.web: When did we see you sick, or in prison, and come to you?’
39.asv: And when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

40.web: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
40.asv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it unto one of these my brethren, even these least, ye did it unto me.

41.web: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;
41.asv: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels:

42.web: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;
42.asv: for I was hungry, and ye did not give me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink;

43.web: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’
43.asv: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in; naked, and ye clothed me not; sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

44.web: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’
44.asv: Then shall they also answer, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

45.web: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’
45.asv: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not unto one of these least, ye did it not unto me.

46.web: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
46.asv: And these shall go away into eternal punishment: but the righteous into eternal life.
